headline: Strip internal-rules narrative from operator-facing surface
summary: Documentation-only minor-line opener. Removes residual references to internal contributor-rules files and tightens before/now narrative that had leaked into README, comments, error messages, and the systemd unit drop-ins. No code or wire-protocol changes; behavior is byte-identical to v0.7.17.

items.title: README, inline comments, and error messages reworded to drop internal narrative
items.body: Operator-facing prose across `README.md`, public-API JSDoc, CLI `--help` text, error messages thrown from public entry points, and the shipped `deploy/` units no longer references contributor-rules file paths or carries before/now framing that only makes sense with prior-conversation context. Each line now reads as a self-contained statement of what the surface is or does.
